conversation.title: Conversation (Grok)
conversation.description: Assist LLM tools, live search, and model pickers. Models are loaded live from GET https://api.x.ai/v1/models.

data.max_tokens: Maximum tokens to return in response
data.auto_model_routing: Auto-route simple requests to fast model

data_description.prompt: Instruct how Grok should respond. This can be a template.
data_description.reasoning_effort: Controls reasoning effort for Grok reasoning models (low/medium/high).
data_description.live_search: xAI server-side Web and/or X search. Works with Assist tools (two-pass: search brief → tool loop).
data_description.interaction_mode: tools = direct HA tool calling; pipeline = try HA Assist first; chat_only = no device control.
data_description.location_context: e.g. Calgary, Alberta, Canada — sent to live search for 'near me' / local queries.
data_description.fast_model: Used when auto-routing detects a short/simple command. List is loaded live from xAI.
data_description.fallback_model: Tried automatically if the primary model errors. List is loaded live from xAI.
data_description.chat_model: Main conversation model from GET /v1/models (image/voice models filtered out). You can type a model id.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Select Assist so Grok can call HassTurnOn / HassTurnOff and control exposed lights.
data_description.budget_warn_usd: Fires spacexai_budget_warning when estimated spend crosses this USD value.

add_profile.title: Add New Voice Profile
add_profile.description: Create a new voice profile. xAI provides 25+ voices (Eve, Ara, Rex, Luna, Helios, Zagan, …) listed live from GET /v1/tts/voices.

data_description.profile_name: A unique name for this voice profile (e.g., 'Morning News', 'Bedtime Stories')
data_description.voice: xAI voice (Eve, Ara, Rex, Luna, … or a custom voice_id)
data_description.language: Language code for speech (e.g., en, es, fr, de, auto for auto-detect)
data_description.codec: Audio codec: MP3 (compressed), WAV (uncompressed), PCM, or telephony formats (G.711)
data_description.sample_rate: Audio sample rate in Hz. Higher = better quality, larger file
data_description.bit_rate: Bit rate for MP3 compression. Higher = better quality, larger file (MP3 only)
